Name: Simple Smart Planting
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Smart Planting[/size][/b]
Make planting easier by spreading seeds or fertilizer across connected tilled soil using the stack you’re holding.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Connected Field:[/b] Plant across soil connected by sides or corners.[/*]
[*][b]Sprinkler support:[/b] Reach soil around sprinklers without spending items on their tiles.[/*]
[*][b]Seeds and fertilizer:[/b] Plant on fertilized soil or fertilize planted crops whenever the game normally allows it.[/*]
[*][b]Placement preview:[/b] See which tiles will be affected and how many items will be used.[/*]
[*][b]Optional Radius mode:[/b] Choose a smaller planting area instead of filling the connected field.[/*]
[*][b]Hold or Toggle controls:[/b] Choose your preferred activation style with configurable bindings.[/*]
[*][b]Crop protection:[/b] Existing crops are never replaced.[/*]
[*][b]Mixed Crop Protection:[/b] Optionally keep a gap around different crops.[/*]
[*][b]Season Safety:[/b] Optionally prevent planting crops that won’t mature before the season ends.[/*]
[*][b]Selected stack only:[/b] Never takes items from other stacks or chests.[/*]
[*][b]12 languages:[/b] Follows your game’s selected language.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]SMAPI[/b] is required. [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional for adjusting settings.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
Extract [b]SimpleSmartPlanting[/b] into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI.
